learning_outcomes.text: Explain realistic AI use cases across nonprofits and social-impact organizations
Use AI tools effectively and ground their output
Use AI to support fundraising and programme content
Apply AI to support operations and supporter engagement
Govern AI use for risk, confidentiality and accuracy and beneficiary fairness
Lead responsible, ethical AI adoption in nonprofits and social-impact organizations

integrative_case: A nonprofit lead wants to use AI across nonprofits and social-impact organizations without overstating impact or mishandling data. Map suitable use cases, use AI to draft fundraising content and support engagement with grounding and review, classify donor and beneficiary data and design an approval and audit trail, plan a safe pilot, and set a policy covering accuracy, beneficiary fairness and disclosure.
assesses: knowledge and applied reasoning on every in-scope outcome via MCQ/MR
case-based decisions in the integrative case
